title: Runlayer Sues HR Giant Rippling: Accuses It of Using Probation Period to Steal Code 1:1 Clone AI Gateway

content_html:
According to AIbase, the startup Runlayer, which develops a secure model context protocol (MCP) gateway, has formally filed a lawsuit against the human resources software giant Rippling, accusing it of stealing trade secrets, unfair competition, and breaching contracts during a product trial period. The case is handled by the renowned law firm Sullivan & Cromwell, highlighting the trust and security challenges faced when selling AI infrastructure to enterprise customers with in-house development capabilities.

The complaint reveals that Rippling had engaged in intensive engineering collaboration and product trials with Runlayer for nearly a year, during which Runlayer shared its product roadmap and even source code under a confidentiality agreement. However, after the trial was terminated due to disagreements over pricing, insiders from Rippling leaked that the company was developing a clone product that replicates Runlayer's offering. In response, Rippling confirmed that it is launching an in-house MCP gateway but strongly denied the allegations of infringement, stating that the product was independently developed using proprietary technology.

Since Anthropic open-sourced the MCP protocol at the end of 2024, MCP gateways have become essential infrastructure for securely connecting AI agents to external data. Runlayer's recent lawsuit, which has raised $42 million in funding from institutions like Khosla Ventures, highlights the industry risk of technology imitation during deep trials in the enterprise AI tools market, sounding a safety alarm for the entire AI infrastructure sector.

content_html_zh:
据AIbase报道，开发安全模型上下文协议（MCP）网关的初创公司Runlayer已正式对人力资源软件巨头Rippling提起诉讼，指控其窃取商业机密、不正当竞争以及在产品试用期间违反合同。 该案由著名律师事务所 Sullivan & Cromwell 处理，凸显了向具有内部开发能力的企业客户销售人工智能基础设施时面临的信任和安全挑战。

投诉显示，Rippling 与 Runlayer 进行了近一年的密集工程合作和产品试验，在此期间，Runlayer 在保密协议下分享了其产品路线图甚至源代码。 然而，在试验因定价分歧而终止后，Rippling 内部人士透露，该公司正在开发一款复制 Runlayer 产品的克隆产品。 对此，Rippling 证实其正在推出内部 MCP 网关，但强烈否认侵权指控，称该产品是使用专有技术独立开发的。

自 Anthropic 于 2024 年底开源 MCP 协议以来，MCP 网关已成为将 AI 代理安全连接到外部数据的重要基础设施。 Runlayer最近的诉讼已从Khosla Ventures等机构筹集了4200万美元资金，凸显了企业AI工具市场深度试验过程中技术模仿的行业风险，为整个AI基础设施领域敲响了安全警钟。
